decisions.host: shin (ש, with hiriq), the syllable before the yod
decisions.source_evidence: Panel 325-1-0, line 3 (continues from panel 325-1-1, line 3: 'וְנִחְיֶה וְנִרְאֶה וְנִירַשׁ טוֹבָה ...'), the last word of 'וּבְרָכָה לִשְׁנֵי יְמוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ'. Under המשיח there is a T-shaped qamats under the mem, which has a dagesh. Further along, under the shin, there is a short separate vertical stroke. Hiriq is a dot and has no vertical part, so a stroke under the shin can't belong to that vowel. It doesn't look like a smudge or part of the qamats either. That makes it the meteg on the shin, which matches the 'restored' form. Caveat: at this enlargement I can't clearly pick out the hiriq dot itself or the patach marks under the ה and ח, so I could only check that the base letters (ה מ ש י ח) and the qamats match the target. I found no conflict between the source and the target, but I couldn't fully confirm the other vowels.
